    Geometric characterizations over an algebraically closed field #

    Theorem 6.1 (Theorem A(III)) of the manuscript. Over an algebraically closed field k, this file connects E-finiteness in the chosen split basic Morita presentation (basicPresentation k R) with the King moduli criterion isEFinite_iff_kingClosedPoints, complementing the open-orbit and open-wide-locus equivalences (equivalences_openLoci).
